finished_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE square standalone original S002 sunlit brushstroke landscape artwork on white marker paper. Transparent oil/alcohol student-marker aesthetic, broad readable color masses and selective natural short plant strokes, sunny light and shadow groups, airy white paper, NO thick black outlines, NO cute faces. No printed words, numbers, panels, color swatches, watermarks or tools. Use only stated approximate hue families, slight same-marker overlap allowed; no smooth digital gradients, opaque impasto or pale strokes painted over dark. Reserve white shapes BEFORE color. No unnecessary microdetail or dense all-over texture. Narrow natural white margins. Composition must be distinct from other scenes. Intended for 16.5cm square marker paper. Stage: D4 independent project exemplar, composition and decisions matter, not necessarily more details than D3. Scene: View OUT through an open window, only minimal pale beige bottom sill and one side frame visible, outdoors dominates: a small olive shrub lit by early sun beside a pale gray-green lawn and a slender ochre path, pale cyan sky. Warm-cool balance, white paper sunlit gaps. No indoor props, curtains, furniture or opaque glow. Natural sunny brushstroke landscape, medium detail. Framing is deliberate and composition airy. Palette: 25 very pale gray-beige; 67 pale cyan; 172 extremely pale gray-green; 44 yellow olive; 41 dark olive; 95 ochre brown; 143 extremely pale blue-gray. Keep relative hue character, these are planning labels not calibrated exact colors.

instruction_pages.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Create one large legible teaching page, 2x2 grid FOUR LARGE panels. D4 autonomous composition helper, not a copy-along finished picture. Panels are thumbnail choices, large masses, structure, palette/order. Each diagram is only one possible solution.  Attached artwork is composition and palette reference, NEVER copy finished colors into early stages. S002 sunlit natural brushstroke marker style, broad masses, irregular organic plant strokes and white gaps, no circular leaf blobs or dot borders. Title exact Chinese: S002-026 窗外的第一束晴光 · 构思与结构. Top tool codes: 25,67,172,44,41,95,143. Each panel has given numbered Chinese title and ONLY ONE SHORT readable Chinese instruction hint, not the entire paragraph below; drawings occupy most panel area. White page, thin gray dividers, generous margins. The full instructions below constrain what to illustrate, not all to print. Palette: 25 很浅的灰米色、灰肤色（照片观察）; 67 浅青蓝（照片观察）; 172 极浅灰绿（照片观察）; 44 偏黄的橄榄绿（照片观察）; 41 较深橄榄绿（照片观察）; 95 赭棕、黄棕（照片观察）; 143 极浅青灰、蓝灰（照片观察）. Panel instructions: 1 两种小稿 — Show TWO small pencil thumbnails with different focal placement or framing for this same subject, mark A and B, genuinely different possible layouts, no final colors. 2 三组大形 — Chosen-example thumbnail only; show pale flat masses for main subject, support and reserved white; add small light-source arrow and focal dot. 3 结构与留白 — Large pencil STRUCTURE STUDY: 窗只是取景框，窗台平面与侧框立面要分开；主体应在窗外。先画自己的两张小稿再看示意，避免被固定构图替代判断。 Show critical connections and white gaps, no dense foliage. 4 配色与顺序 — Separated numeric color swatches using ONLY 25,67,172,44,41,95,143 and a SIMPLE chosen-example block-in, NOT final rendering. Printed note: 先构思，再按需看示意。. Footer exact: AI教学示意 · 详细操作见正文. Transparent student alcohol/oil markers on 16.5cm paper, light-to-dark, reserve white before color. No opaque white over dark, no smooth digital gradients, no thick black outline. No extra subjects.
